messages.author: Casalini  Tommaso
messages.body:
Dear Amber users and developers,
I need to reinstall Amber16 and, unfortunately, I do not find anywhere AmberTools17 archive (I was careless and I did not keep a copy...).
Although it is not recommended, I try to combine more recent versions of AmberTools with Amber16, but the installation failed.
I would kindly like to ask if it is possible to download again AmberTools17, so that I can proceed with the installation.
I thank you in advance for your help and collaboration.
Best regards,
Tommaso
